text: At the Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre Annual General Meeting held on October 23, 2018, the membership nominated the individuals listed above for appointment by Toronto and East York Community Council to the Board of Management of the Waterfront Neighbourhood Centre. The Board of Management struck a Nominations committee early in 2018 to fill upcoming vacancies on the WNC Board. The Nominations Committee among other duties reviewed the role, responsibilities and required skills of a Board member and for those who have served prior, reviewed their record of attendance, diligence and oversight. The committee also identified additional desirable skills, particularly those being: business and finance and/or fundraising and resource development, with final recommendations presented to the Membership for election at the Annual General Meeting. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed, at the pleasure of Council to the Board of Management the following nominees, whose appointment complies with the Public Appointments Policy and the relevant provisions of the Relationship Framework for Board Operated Community Centres: For the term ending November 30, 2022 or until their successors are appointed: Linda Ballantyne Virginia Martin Brenda McCabe Barbara McKenney Saida Said Carole Therriault Amani Yagob and in addition, the following individual: Cliff Ojala for the term ending November 30, 2020 or until their successor is appointed.
